As part of Pollux, you are given every opportunity to take on responsibilities and develop yourself as a professional and as an individual. What will you be doing? As a cleaning employee, you will be part of our accommodation department and ensure that our accommodations and the office are always clean, tidy, and ready for use. Identifying any damage or irregularities and reporting them to your supervisor. Collaborating with colleagues to ensure that all locations meet our quality standards.
